scope: Adversarial review of Expedition/Kurio theme alteration before publication. Read source, exercised browser interactions and inspected generated screenshots. No implementation edits by reviewer.

finding.issue: At narrow/mobile widths Expedition CSS hid theme button text while icons were aria-hidden, leaving two unnamed buttons.
finding.reproduction: 320px viewport; getByRole group Tema visual contained buttons with no accessible names, preventing semantic activation.
finding.fix: Author added explicit aria-label for each theme option and restored visible labels in a two-row mobile header. Account control also remains visible.
finding.validation: Subsequent14/14 desktop/mobile browser cases passed, including keyboard focus and controls bounded within320/390/768/1440.

verifiedBehavior: Default theme expedition when preference missing or invalid
Changing theme keeps catalog URL search/filter/sort/page intact
Guest cart item count survives theme switch and document reload
Unsaved profile name remains and keyboard focus stays on activated theme button
Checkout collector name/email and review state remain across themes; no order is created by theme changes
Blocked preference reads/writes do not crash catalog or in-memory theme switching
Both themes maintain document width and header/search/toolbar/title/cart control bounds at320,390,768,1440 pixels

visualInspection.assessment: Original fantasy temple artwork, dark green/gold shell and readable NFT catalog; mobile header exposes account/cart/menu and theme controls in separate rows. No horizontal content loss detected.
visualInspection.baselineCaveat: New screenshots establish regression references; their creation does not certify upstream Figma fidelity.

sourceReview: StyleguideProvider changes context value without keying/remounting the application subtree
Theme name allowlist prevents arbitrary preference values from entering DOM attribute
Preference storage access catches read/write failures
Theme-specific composition/CSS remains isolated from baseline Kurio UI
Theme changes do not enter server-state query keys or clear account/cart data
limitations: Storage-failure scenario targets theme preference access, not complete browser storage destruction.
Old Kurio visual baseline assertions require deliberate update for the added two-row mobile theme control, handled by parent.
Final full functional/visual suite and deployment verification are parent release gates; this report does not claim publication.
